accent.description: Optional instance accent overriding the compiled brand color; users still win with an explicit preset.

content.description: Raw base64 PNG/JPEG; favicon also accepts ICO (PNG or uncompressed DIB frames). Up to 256 KiB; empty restores default. The accent slot takes a #RRGGBB color instead.

reset_allowed.description: Whether this target may be initialized after explicit reset consent. False for another installed instance, or an unrecognized nonempty database during an unlocked reinstall.

upload_path.description: One configured relative upload path; omitted selects the first configured path.

realm.description: Realm the role belongs to; omitted means user for backward compatibility. Update requests cannot move a role between realms.

parent_key.description: Key of the configured page or link row this entry nests under; omitted or empty places the entry at its top-level group. The tree depth is limited to 5 and cycles are rejected on save.

type.description: page rows override a registered route page and never carry url; link rows are operator-created external links with a link: prefixed key and a required url.

url.description: Link target; only link rows carry it. Accepts http(s) URLs or in-site relative paths starting with /.

reset.description: Restore registered defaults for both surfaces; requires super_admin. Empty sections/nodes alone saves an empty tree.
